title: アドバンストバイオ工学
subtitle: Advanced Bioengineering
educationalGoal: The goals are to utilize the knowledge learned in Applied Bioscience and you will understand the advanced-bioengineering field. In this course, you can understand and explain the history of industrial use in the biotechnology fields including food, pharmaceutical product,  chemical compound and the environment. You will learn the fundamental phenomena of the latest findings in bioengineering processes, especially food processing and biotechnology, to utilize the knowledge in your studies and solving social issues.
advice:
Outline of this course

1. History of bioengineering and its application to various fields
2. Bioengineering in the food processing process
3. Basic and advanced knowledge of food technology

The lecture slides will be distributed in the course.
If necessary, you will be used reference book.

The advice for this course

1. Understand the basic and major experiments.
2. Understand the basic characteristics of the major components of food in "Food and Nutrition" and other courses.
3. Quantitative understanding of complex systems such as foods.
books: The reference book covers a wide range of topics in food technology, including heat transfer, sterilization, drying, filtration, and fermentation. And the book also covers HACCP, which has been implemented in food factories since 2021 in Japan. In addition, the book explains various food production processes, including how to make bread, jam, butter, etc...
requiredKnowledge: Requires completion of the “Introduction to Bioengineering”, “Microbiology”, and “Food and Nutrition” courses.

              The goals are to utilize the knowledge learned in Applied Bioscience and you will understand the advanced-bioengineering field. In this course, you can understand and explain the history of industrial use in the biotechnology fields including food, pharmaceutical product,  chemical compound and the environment. You will learn the fundamental phenomena of the latest findings in bioengineering processes, especially food processing and biotechnology, to utilize the knowledge in your studies and solving social issues.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Outline of this course

1. History of bioengineering and its application to various fields
2. Bioengineering in the food processing process
3. Basic and advanced knowledge of food technology

The lecture slides will be distributed in the course.
If necessary, you will be used reference book.

The advice for this course

1. Understand the basic and major experiments.
2. Understand the basic characteristics of the major components of food in "Food and Nutrition" and other courses.
3. Quantitative understanding of complex systems such as foods.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              The reference book covers a wide range of topics in food technology, including heat transfer, sterilization, drying, filtration, and fermentation. And the book also covers HACCP, which has been implemented in food factories since 2021 in Japan. In addition, the book explains various food production processes, including how to make bread, jam, butter, etc...

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Requires completion of the “Introduction to Bioengineering”, “Microbiology”, and “Food and Nutrition” courses.
